keyPoints.en: Independence (kemerdekaan) means freedom from colonial rule, with the right to govern ourselves.
keyPoints.bm: Kemerdekaan bermaksud bebas daripada penjajahan, dengan hak memerintah sendiri.

keyPoints.en: The textbook gives views of Sayyid Jamal al-Din al-Afghani, Rashid Rida, Mahatma Gandhi, Nelson Mandela, President Soekarno, Tunku Abdul Rahman, Tun Temenggong Jugah, Tun Fuad Stephens and Tun Dr Mahathir Mohamad.
keyPoints.bm: Buku teks memberikan pandangan Sayyid Jamal al-Din al-Afghani, Rashid Rida, Mahatma Gandhi, Nelson Mandela, Presiden Soekarno, Tunku Abdul Rahman, Tun Temenggong Jugah, Tun Fuad Stephens dan Tun Dr Mahathir Mohamad.

keyPoints.en: Common ideas: freedom of body and mind, sovereignty, the people's dignity, and the duty to "fill" independence with progress.
keyPoints.bm: Idea yang sama: kebebasan fizikal dan minda, kedaulatan, maruah rakyat, serta tanggungjawab "mengisi" kemerdekaan dengan kemajuan.

meaning.en: Freedom from foreign rule; the right to make our own laws and decisions.
meaning.bm: Bebas daripada pemerintahan asing; hak membuat undang-undang dan keputusan sendiri.

meaning.en: Using our freedom well — studying, working, staying united and contributing to the nation.
meaning.bm: Menggunakan kebebasan dengan baik — belajar, bekerja, bersatu dan menyumbang kepada negara.

points.en: Political: the country is sovereign and rules itself.
points.bm: Politik: negara berdaulat dan memerintah sendiri.

points.en: Mental: people are free from a colonised way of thinking.
points.bm: Minda: rakyat bebas daripada pemikiran terjajah.

points.en: Responsibility: citizens must defend and develop what was won.
points.bm: Tanggungjawab: rakyat mesti mempertahankan dan membangunkan apa yang telah dicapai.

question.en: Why is it important to remember how independence was achieved?
question.bm: Mengapakah penting untuk mengingati cara kemerdekaan dicapai?

answer.en: Malaya won independence through negotiation and inter-ethnic unity, not war; remembering this teaches us to solve problems peacefully and protect unity.
answer.bm: Tanah Melayu mencapai kemerdekaan melalui rundingan dan perpaduan kaum, bukan peperangan; mengingatinya mengajar kita menyelesaikan masalah secara aman dan menjaga perpaduan.

keyPoints.en: Two committees prepared the celebrations: a Physical Preparations Committee and a Celebrations Committee.
keyPoints.bm: Dua jawatankuasa membuat persediaan sambutan: Jawatankuasa Persediaan Fizikal dan Jawatankuasa Sambutan.

keyPoints.en: Stadium Merdeka in Kuala Lumpur was built for the proclamation ceremony.
keyPoints.bm: Stadium Merdeka di Kuala Lumpur dibina untuk istiadat pemasyhuran.

keyPoints.en: Guests from many countries were invited, including the Duke of Gloucester, representing Queen Elizabeth II.
keyPoints.bm: Tetamu dari banyak negara dijemput, termasuk Duke of Gloucester yang mewakili Ratu Elizabeth II.

meaning.en: Stadium in Kuala Lumpur where independence was proclaimed on 31 August 1957.
meaning.bm: Stadium di Kuala Lumpur tempat kemerdekaan dimasyhurkan pada 31 Ogos 1957.

meaning.en: Prince Henry, the Queen's representative at the ceremony.
meaning.bm: Putera Henry, wakil Ratu dalam istiadat itu.

points.en: Prepared venues — especially Stadium Merdeka — roads, lighting and decorations in Kuala Lumpur.
points.bm: Menyediakan tempat — terutamanya Stadium Merdeka — jalan raya, lampu dan hiasan di Kuala Lumpur.

points.en: Planned the ceremonies and programmes, invited foreign guests and organised celebrations across the country.
points.bm: Merancang istiadat dan atur cara, menjemput tetamu asing dan menganjurkan sambutan di seluruh negara.

question.en: State TWO preparations made for the proclamation of independence.
question.bm: Nyatakan DUA persediaan untuk pemasyhuran kemerdekaan.

answer.en: Building Stadium Merdeka for the ceremony; inviting foreign guests such as the Duke of Gloucester and planning celebrations nationwide.
answer.bm: Membina Stadium Merdeka untuk istiadat; menjemput tetamu asing seperti Duke of Gloucester dan merancang sambutan di seluruh negara.

keyPoints.en: At midnight on 30–31 August 1957 at the Selangor Club padang (now Dataran Merdeka), the Union Jack was lowered and the Federation of Malaya flag was raised.
keyPoints.bm: Pada tengah malam 30–31 Ogos 1957 di padang Kelab Selangor (kini Dataran Merdeka), bendera Union Jack diturunkan dan bendera Persekutuan Tanah Melayu dinaikkan.

keyPoints.en: On the morning of 31 August 1957 at Stadium Merdeka, the Duke of Gloucester handed over the instrument of independence.
keyPoints.bm: Pada pagi 31 Ogos 1957 di Stadium Merdeka, Duke of Gloucester menyerahkan surat cara kemerdekaan.

keyPoints.en: Tunku Abdul Rahman read the Proclamation of Independence and shouted "Merdeka!" seven times.
keyPoints.bm: Tunku Abdul Rahman membaca Pemasyhuran Kemerdekaan dan melaungkan "Merdeka!" sebanyak tujuh kali.

keyPoints.en: Negaraku was played and the national flag was raised.
keyPoints.bm: Lagu Negaraku dimainkan dan bendera kebangsaan dinaikkan.

meaning.en: The official declaration read by Tunku, written in Malay (Jawi) and English.
meaning.bm: Pengisytiharan rasmi yang dibaca Tunku, ditulis dalam bahasa Melayu (Jawi) dan Inggeris.

meaning.en: The British flag, lowered at midnight as British rule ended.
meaning.bm: Bendera British, diturunkan pada tengah malam apabila pemerintahan British berakhir.

points.en: Huge crowds gathered at the Selangor Club padang; lights were switched off and then on as the new flag rose.
points.bm: Orang ramai berhimpun di padang Kelab Selangor; lampu dipadamkan lalu dinyalakan semula ketika bendera baharu dinaikkan.

heading.en: b. Historic event at Stadium Merdeka
heading.bm: b. Peristiwa bersejarah di Stadium Merdeka

points.en: Attended by the Malay rulers, the Duke of Gloucester, foreign guests and thousands of people.
points.bm: Dihadiri raja-raja Melayu, Duke of Gloucester, tetamu asing dan ribuan rakyat.

points.en: Tunku read the Proclamation and led the cry of "Merdeka!" seven times; prayers were recited and Negaraku played.
points.bm: Tunku membaca Pemasyhuran dan memimpin laungan "Merdeka!" tujuh kali; doa dibacakan dan lagu Negaraku dimainkan.

event.en: Union Jack lowered at the Selangor Club padang.
event.bm: Union Jack diturunkan di padang Kelab Selangor.

event.en: Tuanku Abdul Rahman installed as the first Yang di-Pertuan Agong.
event.bm: Tuanku Abdul Rahman ditabalkan sebagai Yang di-Pertuan Agong pertama.

alt.bm: Tunku Abdul Rahman memasyhurkan kemerdekaan di Stadium Merdeka, 31 Ogos 1957.

question.en: Why did the ceremony include both the Malay rulers and the British representative?
question.bm: Mengapakah istiadat itu melibatkan raja-raja Melayu dan wakil British?

answer.en: It showed a peaceful, lawful transfer of power agreed by Britain, the rulers and the people's leaders.
answer.bm: Ia menunjukkan penyerahan kuasa yang aman dan sah, dipersetujui British, raja-raja dan pemimpin rakyat.

keyPoints.en: Independence brought political, economic and social changes.
keyPoints.bm: Kemerdekaan membawa perubahan politik, ekonomi dan sosial.

keyPoints.en: Political: a sovereign country with its own Parliament and government; Malaya joined the United Nations (September 1957).
keyPoints.bm: Politik: negara berdaulat dengan Parlimen dan kerajaan sendiri; Tanah Melayu menyertai Pertubuhan Bangsa-Bangsa Bersatu (September 1957).

keyPoints.en: Economic: the government planned its own development, especially rural development.
keyPoints.bm: Ekonomi: kerajaan merancang pembangunan sendiri, terutamanya pembangunan luar bandar.

keyPoints.en: Social: a national education system, the national language and efforts to unite the people.
keyPoints.bm: Sosial: sistem pendidikan kebangsaan, bahasa kebangsaan dan usaha menyatupadukan rakyat.

meaning.en: World organisation of sovereign states; Malaya became a member on 17 September 1957.
meaning.bm: Pertubuhan antarabangsa negara berdaulat; Tanah Melayu menjadi ahli pada 17 September 1957.

points.en: Tunku Abdul Rahman became the first Prime Minister; Tuanku Abdul Rahman of Negeri Sembilan the first Yang di-Pertuan Agong.
points.bm: Tunku Abdul Rahman menjadi Perdana Menteri pertama; Tuanku Abdul Rahman dari Negeri Sembilan menjadi Yang di-Pertuan Agong pertama.

points.en: Own foreign policy; membership of the UN and the Commonwealth.
points.bm: Dasar luar sendiri; keahlian PBB dan Komanwel.

points.en: Development plans for roads, schools, clinics and land schemes (e.g. FELDA, 1956) to raise rural living standards.
points.bm: Rancangan pembangunan untuk jalan raya, sekolah, klinik dan skim tanah (cth. FELDA, 1956) bagi meningkatkan taraf hidup luar bandar.

points.en: National education based on the Razak Report; Malay as the national language; national symbols that unite the people.
points.bm: Pendidikan kebangsaan berasaskan Penyata Razak; bahasa Melayu sebagai bahasa kebangsaan; lambang negara yang menyatukan rakyat.

question.en: Give ONE political effect of independence.

answer.en: Malaya became a sovereign state with its own elected government and Parliament, and joined the United Nations.
answer.bm: Tanah Melayu menjadi negara berdaulat dengan kerajaan dan Parlimen sendiri yang dipilih, dan menyertai PBB.

keyPoints.en: As a sovereign nation, the Federation of Malaya had six principles of sovereignty.
keyPoints.bm: Sebagai negara berdaulat, Persekutuan Tanah Melayu mempunyai enam prinsip kedaulatan.

keyPoints.en: Sovereignty, territory, government, rule of law, national symbols and recognition as citizens.
keyPoints.bm: Kedaulatan, wilayah pengaruh, kerajaan, kedaulatan undang-undang, lambang kebangsaan dan pengiktirafan sebagai rakyat.

meaning.en: Everyone, including the government, must follow the law; the Constitution is supreme.
meaning.bm: Semua pihak, termasuk kerajaan, mesti mematuhi undang-undang; Perlembagaan adalah tertinggi.

meaning.en: The flag, the anthem Negaraku, the coat of arms (Jata Negara) and the national language.
meaning.bm: Bendera, lagu kebangsaan Negaraku, Jata Negara dan bahasa kebangsaan.

points.en: a. Sovereignty: free to make decisions without outside control.
points.bm: a. Kedaulatan: bebas membuat keputusan tanpa kawalan luar.

points.en: b. Territory: the 11 states of the Federation.
c. Government: constitutional monarchy and parliamentary democracy.
points.bm: c. Kerajaan: raja berperlembagaan dan demokrasi berparlimen.

points.en: d. Rule of law: the Constitution is the supreme law.
points.bm: d. Kedaulatan undang-undang: Perlembagaan ialah undang-undang tertinggi.

points.en: e. National symbols: the 1957 flag had 11 red and white stripes and an 11-point star (14 from 1963; named Jalur Gemilang in 1997); Negaraku; the Jata Negara with the motto "Bersekutu Bertambah Mutu".
points.bm: e. Lambang kebangsaan: bendera 1957 mempunyai 11 jalur merah putih dan bintang 11 bucu (14 mulai 1963; dinamakan Jalur Gemilang pada 1997); Negaraku; Jata Negara dengan cogan kata "Bersekutu Bertambah Mutu".

points.en: f. Recognition as citizens: citizenship gives rights and responsibilities.
points.bm: f. Pengiktirafan sebagai rakyat: kewarganegaraan memberi hak dan tanggungjawab.

question.en: What did the 11-point star and 11 stripes of the 1957 flag represent?
question.bm: Apakah yang dilambangkan oleh bintang 11 bucu dan 11 jalur bendera 1957?

answer.en: The 11 states of the Federation of Malaya united as one nation.
answer.bm: 11 buah negeri Persekutuan Tanah Melayu yang bersatu sebagai satu negara.

tip.en: Six principles: Kedaulatan, Wilayah, Kerajaan, Undang-undang, Lambang, Rakyat.
tip.bm: Enam prinsip: Kedaulatan, Wilayah, Kerajaan, Undang-undang, Lambang, Rakyat.
